document.abstract: Eastman Color Negative Film 7291 is a 16-mm film with an exposure index (EI) of 100. This new film replaces Eastman Color Negative II Film 7247 and features improved speed balance, image structure, color reproduction, processing characteristics, and dye stability. The 7291 film is designed to be completely compatible with its counterpart, Eastman Color High Speed Negative Film 7294. Consequently, scenes may be shot on 7291 and 7294 films and intercut together to produce high-quality motion pictures.
